messages:
maya patel: starting a quick canary for routing-v2 in quiet window. feature flag `route.v2_enabled` will ramp slowly. initial set to 1%.

deploy-bot: queued deploy id db-9902. healthchecks enabled.

sam wilson: ramp plan: 1% -> 5% @10m -> 25% @30m -> 60% @75m -> 100% @3h if stable. rollback triggers: error_rate >0.7% or p95 +150ms. manual hold at 60%.

jordan lee: KV cache warmup note: expect transient p95 bump first 4m. ignore blips <3m. prepping pin script for fast rollback.

maya patel: adding auto-pin on rollback: `POST /flags/pin {"flag":"route.v2_enabled","version":"model-v1-stable","ttl":1800}`. also increase tracing sample for 10m after 25% step.

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 1%. healthchecks passing 3/3.

sam wilson: 5% -> p95 +20ms, errors unchanged. moving to 25% as scheduled.

jordan lee: 25% hold: traces look fine. if anything weird, we'll trigger pin and rollback.

deploy-bot: ramp to 60% scheduled, manual holdpoint waiting.

sam wilson: holdpoint at 60% reached, metrics stable. oncall reviewed and approved continue to 100%.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: routing-v2 at 100% traffic. no rollback triggered. release notes: "routing-v2 rolled with staged FF ramp; auto-pin on rollback; warmup guidance added."

maya patel: nice work. will file a short retro on thresholds and warmup ignore window. :tada:
